credits.title: Roots
credits.overview: When an ancestry test leaves Andre, a Black teenager adopted into a white family, questioning his place among those he loves most, he turns to his older brother for help. Together, they devise an unlikely plan to convince their parents that he is their biological son.

credits.title: Napalm Roses
credits.overview: When faced with the chance to be taken away from your lugubrious state towards an alluring otherworld of opportunity and community, you can't help but run towards that dream. However, when that dream transforms into disturbing distrust, a nobler future entails the pursuit of self-determination.

credits.title: In Corpore
credits.overview: Four couples deal with love and lust, commitment and infidelity, and the pressures of relationship expectations. Filmed in Melbourne, Berlin, Malta, and New York, In Corpore tackles the consequences faced when one chooses to either suppress or give into the inner desires of body and soul.

credits.title: King Night
credits.overview: A woman's mental state unravels when her partner's mother comes to visit, bringing with her a gift that could have horrifying consequences.

credits.title: Cat Sick Blues
credits.overview: When Ted’s beloved cat dies, the trauma triggers a terrible mental breakdown. His broken brain prompts him to bring his feline friend back – all he needs is nine human lives. credits.title: Plunge
credits.overview: A romantic day trip tests the relationship of two young lovers.
